summary: Threat-model, review, and map ownership of security-sensitive systems.

skills.choose_when: The task asks who owns security-sensitive code, bus factor, stewardship, or CODEOWNERS gaps.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for general contributor statistics or ordinary code review.
skills.name: map-security-ownership

skills.choose_when: The primary task is secure-coding review, vulnerability analysis, or framework-specific hardening.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a general quality review with no security focus.
skills.name: review-security-practices

skills.choose_when: The task explicitly needs assets, trust boundaries, attacker goals, abuse cases, attack paths, or a threat model.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a narrow code finding that is already known.
skills.name: threat-model-system
